messages:
Maria Lopez: Hey folks — opened a PR to add an SR‑IOV networking example and a PKCS#11/HSM caveat for private/on‑prem installs. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4723
Kevin Tran: Nice. quick question: does SR‑IOV require host kernel modules? we should call out driver prereqs explicitly.
Maria Lopez: Yep. I added a short prereqs section but want to surface the ixgbevf/vfio drivers and kernel >= 5.10. Also included a short how‑to for pinning VFs to the installer VM.
Samir Patel: Quick nit: the PKCS#11 section calls `slot-id` optional — that confused our QA. HSMs often enumerate multiple slots; we should show how to map slot numbers to tokens. Suggest adding a `pkcs11-tool` example.
Maria Lopez: Good idea. I'll add an example output for clarity: ```
$ pkcs11-tool --list-slots
Slot 0: Manufacturer: SoftHSM
Slot 1: Manufacturer: Thales
```
Anya Chen: Also note networking: include a snippet for allowing link‑local and metadata egress during bootstrap. Some airgapped customers rely on link‑local KMS proxies and don't have NAT.
Kevin Tran: Can we include a QA fallback like `--kms-url file:///` or a local mock HSM endpoint for fully offline test installs? That helped with our integration tests.
docs-bot: PR opened by Maria Lopez — CI: docs-lint passed, linkcheck failed (2 broken links).
Samir Patel: Linkcheck failures: vendor driver link 404 and one internal KB redirect. I'll push a tiny patch to swap the vendor URL and fix the KB anchor.
Maria Lopez: Thanks Samir. One more ask: we should add a migration note for customers moving from single‑NIC to SR‑IOV setups — how to migrate Multus annotations and preserve interface names during transition.
Anya Chen: Agreed — include a `udev` rule example to keep stable NIC names, e.g.: ```
SUBSYSTEM=="net", ATTR{address}=="aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff", NAME="eth0"
```
Kevin Tran: LGTM after those edits. I'll do final review tomorrow morning and merge if CI is green.
Maria Lopez: :thumbsup: I'll update the PR now and add the pkcs11 output + udev snippet.
